summary: Compositing and layers work improved scrolling and input handling through better APZ (Async Pan/Zoom) messaging, DPI-aware autoscroll, overscroll behavior, pinch handling, and safer scroll-state bookkeeping. Firefox also expanded recycling and synchronization of GPU surfaces for WebGL, WebGPU, video, and platform-specific buffers on Android, macOS, Linux, and Windows. HDR video handling now preserves color and metadata more reliably, including Wayland cases, while IPC validation and fence management reduce crashes, stale references, and unsafe cross-process resource use.
